{"code": "s0 = name = '§1. Tax imposed', sources=['s0']
s1 = name = '(a) Married individuals filing joint returns and surviving spouses', sources=['s1']
s2 = name = 'There is hereby imposed on the taxable income of-', sources=['s2']
s3 = name = '    (1) every married individual (as defined in section 7703) who makes a single return jointly with his spouse, and', sources=['s3']
s4 = name = '    (2) every surviving spouse (as defined in section 2(a))', sources=['s4']
s5 = name = 'a tax determined in accordance with the following:', sources=['s5']
s6 = name = '    (i) 15% of taxable income if the taxable income is not over $36,900;', sources=['s6']
s7 = name = '$5,535, plus 28% of the excess over $36,900 if the taxable income is over $36,900 but not over $89,150;', sources=['s7']
s8 = name = '$20,165, plus 31% of the excess over $89,150 if the taxable income is over $89,150 but not over $140,000;', sources=['s8']
s9 = name = '$35,928.50, plus 36% of the excess over $140,000 if the taxable income is over $140,000 but not over $250,000;', sources=['s9']
s10 = name = '$75,528.50, plus 39.6% of the excess over $250,000 if the taxable income is over $250,000.', sources=['s10']
s11 = name = '(b) Heads of households', sources=['s11']
s12 = name = 'There is hereby imposed on the taxable income of every head of a household (as defined in section 2(b)) a tax determined in accordance with the following:', sources=['s12']
s13 = name = '    (i) 15% of taxable income if the taxable income is not over $29,600;', sources=['s13']
s14 = name = '$4,440, plus 28% of the excess over $29,600 if the taxable income is over $29,600 but not over $76,400;', sources=['s14']
s15 = name = '$17,544, plus 31% of the excess over $76,400 if the taxable income is over $76,400 but not over $127,500;', sources=['s15']
s16 = name = '$33,385, plus 36% of the excess over $127,500 if the taxable income is over $127,500 but not over $250,000;', sources=['s16']
s17 = name = '$77,485, plus 39.6% of the excess over $250,000 if the taxable income is over $250,000.', sources=['s17']
s18 = name = '(c) Unmarried individuals (other than surviving spouses and heads of households)', sources=['s18']
s19 = name = 'There is hereby imposed on the taxable income of every individual (other than a surviving spouse as defined in section 2(a) or the head of a household as defined in section 2(b)) who is not a married individual (as defined in section 7703) a tax determined in accordance with the following:', sources=['s19']
s20 = name = '    (i) 15% of taxable income if the taxable income is not over $22,100;', sources=['s20']
s21 = name = '$3,315, plus 28% of the excess over $22,100 if the taxable income is over $22,100 but not over $53,500;', sources=['s21']
s22 = name = '$12,107, plus 31% of the excess over $53,500 if the taxable income is over $53,500 but not over $115,000;', sources=['s22']
s23 = name = '$31,172, plus 36% of the excess over $115,000 if the taxable income is over $115,000 but not over $250,000;', sources=['s23']
s24 = name = '$79,772, plus 39.6% of the excess over $250,000 if the taxable income is over $250,000.', sources=['s24']
s25 = name = '(d) Married individuals filing separate returns', sources=['s25']
s26 = name = 'There is hereby imposed on the taxable income of every married individual (as defined in section 7703) who does not make a single return jointly with his spouse, a tax determined in accordance with the following:', sources=['s26']
s27 = name = '    (i) 15% of taxable income if the taxable income is not over $18,450;', sources=['s27']
s28 = name = '$2,767.50, plus 28% of the excess over $18,450 if the taxable income is over $18,450 but not over $44,575;', sources=['s28']
s29 = name = '$10,082.50, plus 31% of the excess over $44,575 if the taxable income is over $44,575 but not over $70,000;', sources=['s29']
s30 = name = '$17,964.25, plus 36% of the excess over $70,000 if the taxable income is over $70,000 but not over $125,000;', sources=['s30']
s31 = name = '$37,764.25, plus 39.6% of the excess over $125,000 if the taxable income is over $125,000', sources=['s31']
s32 = name = 'Alice is married under section 7703 for the year 2017. Alice's taxable income for the year 2017 is $6662. Alice files a separate return.', sources=['s32']
s33 = name = 'Alice has to pay $999 in taxes for the year 2017 under section 1(d)(iii).', sources=['s33']
query = (999 if (6662 <= 44575 and 6662 >= 18450) else (10082.50 + 0.31 * (6662 - 44575) if (6662 <= 70000 and 6662 >= 44575) else (17964.25 + 0.36 * (6662 - 70000) if (6662 <= 125000 and 6662 >= 70000) else (37764.25 + 0.396 * (6662 - 125000) if (6662 <= 250000 and 6662 >= 125000) else None)))) == 999"}
